description: This file defines the SubscriptionStatus model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for retrieving subscription status records from the database, including fetching individual statuses and lists of all statuses, with caching support.
external_files: database connection and query handling via `$this->db`

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription status data in the database within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a single subscription status record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription status records, with caching to improve performance.
